description: Does a worker reconcile an uncertain completion send as comms spec #delivery-recovery says instead of replaying it (comms #acceptance-queued-completion, worker half; #883)? A worker finishes a small task (an implementer its ticket, a code-reviewer its review) and sends its report with herdr-say --parent; herdr and herdr-say are stand-ins (schema.md, Case, stand_ins), herdr-say's answers canned verbatim from .agents/skills/herdr-comms/assets/herdr-say and scripts/octo-feather-queued at gh840 77a3b40f: a call of the wrong arity (no MESSAGE, an option after --parent) its usage line and 64 (lines 47, 71), --help its usage and 0. queued-timeout-sent-once and reviewer-queued-timeout-sent-once: the send answers the delivery-queued row past its bound, Herdr's timeout error (herdr-say line 133) then the queued line herdr-say's queued decision prints, exit 124 (herdr-say lines 136-140, scripts/octo-feather-queued lines 30-31, 63-67), and herdr agent read shows Pi compacting with a queued Steering line; graded one herdr-say --parent run (schema.md, Run record). blocked-refusal-sent-again, the negative (delivery-rejected row): the first send answers Herdr's native refusal of a blocked target, nothing typed, exit 75 (line 131), every later one delivered; graded two runs. Stated limits: the queued text is canned from the real script, not produced live by a compaction; Herdr's own timeout error JSON is canned (its code and message from Herdr 0.9.5); the stand-in pane's Steering text is fixed, not the worker's report; a message to the director by its pane id instead of --parent is not counted (director.toml is masked in the sandbox).
